verses.text: My soul is weary of my life; I will give free course to my complaint; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

segments.text: My soul is weary of my life;
I will give free course to my complaint;
I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

verses.text: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me; Show me wherefore thou contendest with me.

segments.text: I will say unto God, Do not condemn me;
Show me wherefore thou contendest with me.

verses.text: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress, That thou shouldest despise the work of thy hands, And shine upon the counsel of the wicked?

segments.text: Is it good unto thee that thou shouldest oppress,
That thou shouldest despise the work of thy hands,
And shine upon the counsel of the wicked?

verses.text: Hast thou eyes of flesh? Or seest thou as man seeth?

segments.text: Hast thou eyes of flesh?
Or seest thou as man seeth?

verses.text: Are thy days as the days of man, Or thy years as man’s days,

segments.text: Are thy days as the days of man,
Or thy years as man’s days,

verses.text: That thou inquirest after mine iniquity, And searchest after my sin,

segments.text: That thou inquirest after mine iniquity,
And searchest after my sin,

verses.text: Although thou knowest that I am not wicked, And there is none that can deliver out of thy hand?

segments.text: Although thou knowest that I am not wicked,
And there is none that can deliver out of thy hand?

verses.text: Thy hands have framed me and fashioned me Together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.

segments.text: Thy hands have framed me and fashioned me
Together round about; yet thou dost destroy me.

verses.text: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast fashioned me as clay; And wilt thou bring me into dust again?

segments.text: Remember, I beseech thee, that thou hast fashioned me as clay;
And wilt thou bring me into dust again?

verses.text: Hast thou not poured me out as milk, And curdled me like cheese?

segments.text: Hast thou not poured me out as milk,
And curdled me like cheese?

verses.text: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh, And knit me together with bones and sinews.

segments.text: Thou hast clothed me with skin and flesh,
And knit me together with bones and sinews.

verses.text: Thou hast granted me life and lovingkindness; And thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.

segments.text: Thou hast granted me life and lovingkindness;
And thy visitation hath preserved my spirit.

verses.text: Yet these things thou didst hide in thy heart; I know that this is with thee:

segments.text: Yet these things thou didst hide in thy heart;
I know that this is with thee:

verses.text: If I sin, then thou markest me, And thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.

segments.text: If I sin, then thou markest me,
And thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.

verses.text: If I be wicked, woe unto me; And if I be righteous, yet shall I not lift up my head; Being filled with ignominy, And looking upon mine affliction.

segments.text: If I be wicked, woe unto me;
And if I be righteous, yet shall I not lift up my head;
Being filled with ignominy,
And looking upon mine affliction.

verses.text: And if my head exalt itself, thou huntest me as a lion; And again thou showest thyself marvellous upon me.

verses.text: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, And increasest thine indignation upon me: Changes and warfare are with me.

segments.text: Thou renewest thy witnesses against me,
And increasest thine indignation upon me:

verses.text: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb? I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me.

segments.text: Wherefore then hast thou brought me forth out of the womb?
I had given up the ghost, and no eye had seen me.

verses.text: I should have been as though I had not been; I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

segments.text: I should have been as though I had not been;
I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

verses.text: Are not my days few? cease then, And let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,

segments.text: Are not my days few? cease then,
And let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,

verses.text: Before I go whence I shall not return, Even to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;

to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;

verses.text: The land dark as midnight, The land of the shadow of death, without any order, And where the light is as midnight.
